# tritonctl load-balancer

Manage load balancers

Alias: lb

Subcommands: list, show, create, update, delete

Usage: `tritonctl load-balancer [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>`

## tritonctl load-balancer list

List load balancers in the project, or on one VPC

Alias: ls

Usage: `tritonctl load-balancer list [OPTIONS]`

- `--vpc <VPC>`

## tritonctl load-balancer show

Show one load balancer

Usage: `tritonctl load-balancer show [OPTIONS] <ID>`

- `<ID>`

## tritonctl load-balancer create

Create a load balancer

Usage: `tritonctl load-balancer create [OPTIONS] --name <NAME> --subnet <SUBNET>`

- `--name <NAME>` (required)
- `--description <DESCRIPTION>`
- `--subnet <SUBNET>`: Subnet the load balancer sits in (name, uuid, or prefix) (required)
- `--exposure <EXPOSURE>`: Reachable from outside the VPC, or only inside it (one of: unknown, public, internal; default: public)
- `--spec <FILE>`: The whole spec as a JSON file: listeners, pools, health check
- `--port <PORT>`: Port to listen on
- `--protocol <PROTOCOL>` (one of: tcp, http, https, unknown; default: http)
- `--backend-port <BACKEND_PORT>`: Port the instances serve on
- `--instance <INSTANCE>`: An instance to send traffic to (name, uuid, or prefix). Repeat (repeatable)
- `--tag <KEY=VALUE>`: Also send traffic to every running instance carrying this tag (`key=value`). Repeat to require several (repeatable)
- `--health-path <PATH>`: Probe instances with an HTTP GET of this path instead of a connect
- `--health-host <HOST>`: Host header the health probe sends (default: localhost)

## tritonctl load-balancer update

Replace a load balancer's listeners, pools and health check

Usage: `tritonctl load-balancer update [OPTIONS] --spec <FILE> <ID>`

- `<ID>`
- `--spec <FILE>`: The whole spec as a JSON file (required)

## tritonctl load-balancer delete

Delete a load balancer and release its address

Alias: rm

Usage: `tritonctl load-balancer delete [OPTIONS] <ID>`

- `<ID>`
- `-n, --dry-run`: Print what would change and stop
- `-y, --yes`: Answer yes to the confirmation. The summary still prints
- `--keep-going`: Keep executing after a step fails
